explanation: Fires on the pre-head slot of a noun phrase or argument, i.e. the token right before the head noun is expected: articles (a, the, an, any), prenominal adjectives and modifiers (green, rocky, medial, large, 9x13 inch), and the preposition, conjunction or opening bracket/quote that directly introduces a noun or value (on a, thigh and calf, tree or log, setStyle(', style=", <img). This happens in any register, prose or code, abstract or concrete, usually at 0.25-0.5 of max, and goes highest (above ~0.6 of max) on a physical-attribute adjective (colour, texture, size, anatomical side) directly before a concrete noun; it is near zero on the head noun itself and the tokens after it, on verbs, pronouns, auxiliaries and sentence-final punctuation.
